EPA states that the data from the October/November 2008 comprehensive site-wide ground water sampling event will be used as a baseline to approve the locations and number of additional wells. The data from the Comprehensive Study should be used to evaluate the effectiveness of the existing Groundwater Recovery System and to determine whether additional recovery wells should be installed. Therefore, EPA has incorporated language into the Final Decision to state that after the completion of the Comprehensive Study, which consists of groundwater sampling and sediment and pore water sampling, EPA will evaluate whether additional recovery wells are necessary.
